paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter with a multiple-cell haloscope
notes: Multiple-cell (double-cell) cavity haloscope. Excludes g_agamma >~ 11.1 x g_KSVZ over 13.0-13.9 ueV at 90% CL. KSVZ coupling at ~13.5 ueV (3.25 GHz) is roughly g_KSVZ ~ 6.7e-15 GeV^-1, so the limit is ~7.5e-14 GeV^-1.
